summary.intent: Execute phase 60 wave 1 plans for a FUSE/IPNS codebase, specifically completing plan 60-01 (removing VerifyError::Legacy variant and folding caller arms) and starting plan 60-02 (unifying first-publish IPNS sequence numbers to seq=1).
summary.outcome: Plan 60-01 was verified complete and green — all VerifyError::Legacy references eliminated and three crates compile cleanly. Plan 60-02 was handed off to a subagent.

repo: VerifyError enum had a Legacy variant that was removed in 60-01; all 9 FUSE caller arms were folded to use Invalid instead.
The codebase spans at least three crates: FUSE, desktop Tauri (sdk-core), and web — all touched by the VerifyError refactor.
First-publish IPNS producers previously embedded sequence 0; the target invariant is sequence 1 as a precondition for the strict resolve verifier and API gate.
Vendored fuser crate emits pre-existing dead-code warnings that are expected and not regressions.

code.finding: Was the last reference to VerifyError::Legacy; confirmed removed (now uses Invalid). The E0599 compile error referencing this line was a stale mid-edit snapshot, not a real build failure.

workflow: Diagnostic errors from mid-edit snapshots can be misleading — always re-run cargo check after edits before concluding a compile error is real.
Grep for remaining references is a reliable way to confirm a symbol has been fully eliminated before trusting a compile check.

Wave/plan structure is used to decompose work: 60-01 removes the variant, 60-04 (wave 2) was originally scoped for folding caller arms, but the executor folded them early in 60-01 — scope boundaries can shift during execution.

friction: A stale mid-edit diagnostic (E0599 at metadata.rs:619) created false ambiguity about whether 60-01 was complete, requiring an extra verification round.
Scope overlap between 60-01 and 60-04 (folding FUSE caller arms) caused confusion about what was actually done vs. deferred.
open_items: Plan 60-02 in progress (subagent running): unify all 9 first-publish IPNS producers (FUSE, Tauri, sdk-core, web) to embed sequence 1 instead of 0.
Plans 60-03 through 60-08 (wave 1 and remaining waves) not yet started.
60-04 (wave 2) — originally scoped to fold FUSE caller arms — may need scope reassessment since 60-01 already performed that work.
